newsitem.title: USA: VF to announce $400 mln restructuring-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: VF to announce $400 mln restructuring-WSJ.

text.p: VF Corp is expected to announce a restructuring effort Tuesday that would cut 2,000 to 3,000 jobs over four years, the Wall Street Journal said Tuesday.
The move is expected to cost $400 million but yield about $150 million in annual savings by the year 2000, company Chief Executive Mackey McDonald told the paper.
As part of the restructuring, VF will consolidate its 17 operating divisions into five groups, which should cut administrative costs and streamline factory operations, the report said.
